glosses: decided, fixed, not subject to change
past passive perfective participle of реши́ть (rešítʹ)
перен. ясный, не подлежащий обсуждению или изменению

examples.text: There was a decided ugliness to the patch of waste ground.
The visual indicators are a decided improvement, and have reduced the telephoning by the staff in the signalbox.

glosses: A voter etc. who has reached their decision.

examples.text: […] but that is a highly flawed procedure if the undecideds differ in major ways from the decideds.

glosses: simple past and past participle of decide
Comfortable and at ease, especially after a period of change or unrest.

examples.text: It took me a while to feel settled after I moved to this big city.

glosses: simple past and past participle of settle

examples.text: Tranquilizado, se encamina resuelto hacia el fondo del cuarto. Ella lo oye moverse en la penumbra, tantear los muebles, como si buscara algo. Ahora vuelve sobre sus pasos con un retrato entre las manos.

glosses: Participio irregular de resolver o de resolverse.
